literal_meaning: যা চাইছে তাই (whatever one desires or whatever comes)
figurative_meaning_en: unjust, unreasonable, vile, or vulgar matter
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথাবার্তা যাচ্ছেতাই, কোনো মানেই নেই।
এই যাচ্ছেতাই কাজ করে লাভ কী?
example_sentences_in_english: His talk is all yachetay, it makes no sense.
What's the point of doing things in such a haphazard, vulgar way?
note: This idiom is a colloquial contraction emphasizing lack of propriety or sense in actions or speech.
